title: Project Nimbus Pilot Readiness Review

topics.title: Pilot scope and timing
topics.discussion_summary: The team replaced the proposed 15 October date with a limited 30-user Helsinki customer-service pilot starting 20 October for two weeks.

topics.title: Data protection
topics.discussion_summary: The pilot will use synthetic or anonymized data only; a DPIA is required.

topics.title: Procurement and budget
topics.discussion_summary: Three quotations will be compared; budget approval remains pending.

topics.title: Training and readiness
topics.discussion_summary: Training, sandbox preparation, FAQ preparation, and a go/no-go summary are required before the pilot.

topics.title: Open technical risks
topics.discussion_summary: The SSO approach remains with the architecture board.

decisions.statement: Run a two-week pilot for 30 users in the Helsinki customer service team starting 2026-10-20.
Use only synthetic or anonymized data; do not use production customer data.

action_items.description: Complete the data protection impact assessment.
Configure and test the sandbox using synthetic data.
Draft a short support FAQ before training.
action_items.uncertainty_reason: No owner or exact due date was agreed.

action_items.description: Send the consolidated go/no-go summary to the steering group.

unresolved_issues.description: Final pilot budget approval and the confirmed budget ceiling are pending finance confirmation.
The SSO approach remains undecided pending the architecture board meeting on 2026-09-22.

conflicts.description: The agenda proposed a 2026-10-15 launch, but the meeting explicitly decided on 2026-10-20.

must_not_assert: The 18,000 euro budget ceiling was approved.
The support FAQ has a named owner or exact due date.
